title: 第45章 唐敬在作死的道路上越走越远了
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 直到炎文帝说完，全场一片死寂。炎文帝居高临下看着众人的脸色，看到他们脸上的震惊，他嘴角不由泛起一抹嘲讽。然而，此时此刻他却没有痛骂一场后的得意，只觉得格外悲哀。朝中这些大臣，大多都被靖康耻吓破胆了，内斗猛如虎，外战软如羊。如果朝纲不能重振，下一次恐怕大炎就不会有这么好运了。而这次，如果没有唐逸献计，恐怕这些大臣会联合所有的门阀豪族一起施压，真逼着他向南迁都！率领数十万人，向南迁都。想到那个画面，炎文帝就脊背发凉。而这种事，这些大臣打着为大炎江山社稷的旗号，真干得出来！炎文帝甩了甩脑袋，将脑中杂乱的思绪驱散，不能想，想多了想要杀人。“诸位爱卿，觉得朕此计如何？”炎文帝居高临下，冷声问道。一句话，就像是巴掌一样甩在群臣的脸上。群臣面色讪讪，陛下你是故意的吧？有计你早说啊！你早说，我们也不会说什么迁都这种话了。群臣对炎文帝有些埋怨，但都恭恭敬敬地出声恭维。“陛下圣明，此计定能解我大炎之危机。”“有此策略，定能大破北狄和东虞联军。”“陛下大才，臣等自愧不如！”“……”此时，主张迁都的刘温和唐敬等人，也都老实了。和他们大费周章迁都相比，皇帝的策略明显是上上策，而且仗可能还打不起来，大炎顶多就是失去一部分物资而已。物资，他们不缺！“你们自然是自愧不如，知道这是谁的计策吗？”炎文帝居高临下地盯着众人，嘲讽一笑：“此计，便是写《满江红》和《破阵子》的小诗仙提供的。”“呵呵，满朝文武，竟然比不过一个少年！”“朕，都为你们感到羞耻！”闻言，整个瞬间一片哗然。“竟然是他！”“怎么可能？诗词写得好，谋略也如此高，此人到底是谁？”“小诗仙，别让我知道你是谁……”“……”有人震惊，有人错愕，有人气急败坏，脸色都格外精彩。特别是唐敬，刘温一群人，此时脸上不仅火辣辣的，更有一种被人生生灌了一坨屎的感觉，被恶心到了。那家伙一首《满江红》和《破阵子》，将他们的脸面按在地上摩擦。现在，北狄和东虞六十万联军正准备攻打大炎，他们吓得惊慌失措，又是皇帝的小诗仙站了出来，一计为大炎定北境，安天下。“小诗仙，到底是谁啊……”唐敬，刘温等人都在心头怒吼。唐画脸色青一阵紫一阵，愤怒得青筋凸起。他是状元，今日整个京都最耀眼的应该是他。但现在，风头都被那什么小诗仙给抢了。“该死的，藏头露尾的败类，你算什么东西，也敢和我争？”唐画攥紧拳头，恨欲狂：“无论你是谁，我都会将你踩在脚下，让你知道什么叫天高地厚！”狄苍看着唐敬，刘温等人的表情，脸上别提多嘚瑟了。别说，这种别人不知道，就只有自己知道的感觉，还贼爽！“陛下，小诗仙有如此之才，是我大炎之幸。”唐敬懒得再猜，直接出班问炎文帝：“只是这等天纵奇才，不知是何方高人，还请陛下引荐给臣等认识。”一众大臣，目光也都齐齐落在炎文帝身上。眼神都极为复杂。期待，炙热，愤怒，仇恨……炎文帝很清楚，这里面不少人想要知道唐逸的身份，单纯只是确定他的身份后，除之而后快。只是唐敬啊，那是你的儿子！不知道真相揭露日，你又如何自处呢？炎文帝别有深意地看了一眼唐敬，冷笑开口道：“诸位爱卿放心，再过几日，爱卿们就能见到他了。”“朕，也很期望将他介绍给诸位爱卿认识。”哼哼，朕很想到时候知道唐逸的身份，你们的脸色会何等精彩。沈园诗会，朕还真有点等不及了。“说正事，中书拟旨，八百里加急速呈丞相，让他暂缓回京，立即返回东境，协助大将军苏定安主持东境大局。”“北境，则由边军主帅秦翦主持大局，都察院再挑几个御史北上协助，你们嘴上功夫不是厉害吗？朕倒是要看看你们有没有福王当年的风范。”“最后……”炎文帝目光冷冽扫过全场：“卿等该还钱了！”群臣一听，当时都懵逼了。还钱？还什么钱？！炎文帝冷哼一声，道：“你们从国库拿……不，借走的银两，十日之内，自己还回去。”“十日后，朕会派人亲自查此案，届时被查出来，朕定斩不饶！”“这……都是你们逼朕的！”炎文帝一甩衣袖，转身离开。话说到这份上了，要是还有人找死，那就怪不得他了。而听到炎文帝的话，很多大臣顿时都脸色煞白，冷汗涔涔。国库的钱，大多都是他们以借的方式取出来的，但自始至终，他们都没有想过要还。现在，皇帝让他们还钱了！“小诗仙，又是小诗仙！”相比于欠款，唐敬更关心的是小诗仙的身份。他看向身侧的刑部侍郎赵轲，沉声问道：“怎么，你们还是没查出小诗仙是谁吗？”赵轲睨着唐敬，冷声道：“我们查到的小诗仙，就是你小儿子，唐逸。”唐逸？唐敬和唐画相视一眼，皆不由冷笑道：“不可能，不会是他，他连字都认不全，怎么可能会是那什么诗仙？”赵轲脸色铁青，道：“就是因为不可能，所以我才没有公布，他可能是有人为了混淆视听，故意转移注意力的对象。”有人？除了皇帝还能有谁？唐敬沉吟了一下，微微颔首道：“那就赶紧查，先把这个人查出来，这个人的威胁实在太大了！”以前皇帝很好对付的，自从和那什么小诗仙接触过后，感觉就失控了！再这么下去，谁扛得住？话落，唐敬拱手看向全场，笑着开口。“诸位，今日为了庆祝我儿高中，本官在天香楼设宴，还请诸位赏光。”炎文帝没走多远，听到这话脸色骤沉。大炎现在内忧外患，你竟然还想着庆祝？庆祝什么？庆祝东虞和北狄的联军攻打大炎吗？“陈貂寺！传朕旨意，唐敬教子不严，着免去其侍郎之职……待他宴会开始后，你亲自去！”炎文帝声音低沉，他本暂时不想动唐敬，奈何这老东西在作死的道路上越走越远了。
content_en: Until Emperor Yanwen finished speaking, the whole place was completely silent.Emperor Yanwen looked down at everyone's faces, and when he saw the shock on their faces, he couldn't help but feel a hint of ridicule at the corner of his mouth.However, at this moment, he did not feel proud after scolding him. He only felt extremely sad.Most of the ministers in the court were frightened by Jingkang's humiliation. They were as fierce as tigers in internal fighting and as soft as sheep in external fighting.If Chao Gang can't revive, I'm afraid Dayan won't be so lucky next time.And this time, if Tang Yi hadn't come up with a plan, I'm afraid these ministers would have united with all the powerful families to put pressure on him, really forcing him to move the capital south!He led hundreds of thousands of people and moved the capital south.Thinking of that scene, Emperor Yanwen felt a chill run down his spine.And these ministers can really do this kind of thing under the banner of serving the country!Emperor Yanwen shook his head to dispel the messy thoughts in his mind. He couldn't think about it. He thought too much and wanted to kill someone."My dear friends, what do you think of my plan?" Emperor Yanwen asked in a condescending voice.One sentence was like a slap in the faces of the ministers.The ministers looked embarrassed, Your Majesty, did you do this on purpose?If you have a plan, you should tell me earlier!If you had told us earlier, we wouldn't have talked about moving the capital.The ministers had some complaints against Emperor Yanwen, but they all expressed their compliments respectfully."Your Majesty is wise, this plan will definitely solve our crisis in Great Yan." "With this strategy, we will be able to defeat the coalition forces of Beidi and Dongyu." "Your Majesty is a great talent, I am ashamed of myself!" "..." At this time, Liu Wen, Tang Jing and others who advocated moving the capital also became honest.Compared with them spending a lot of time to move the capital, the emperor's strategy is obviously the best, and the war may not be fought yet, and Dayan will only lose some supplies at most.They have no shortage of supplies!"Of course you are ashamed of yourself. Do you know whose plan this is?" Emperor Yan Wen stared down at everyone and smiled sarcastically: "This plan was provided by the little poetry fairy who wrote "Man Jiang Hong" and "Broken Array"." "Haha, the civil and military forces of the entire dynasty can't compare with a young man!" "I am ashamed of you!" Hearing this, the whole moment was in an uproar."It's him!" "How is it possible? The poems are so good and the strategy is so high. Who is this person?" "Little Poet Fairy, don't let me know who you are..." "..." Some people were shocked, some were stunned, some were furious, and their expressions were particularly wonderful.Especially Tang Jing, Liu Wen and the others, their faces were not only burning at this time, but also felt like they had been sucked into their mouths, and they were disgusted.The guy sang "Man Jiang Hong" and "Broken Array" and rubbed their faces on the ground.Now, the 600,000 coalition forces of Beidi and Dongyu were preparing to attack Dayan. They were frightened and panicked. The emperor's little Shixian stepped forward again and planned to secure the northern territory of Dayan and stabilize the world."Little Shixian, who are you..." Tang Jing, Liu Wen and others roared in their hearts.Tang Hua's face turned blue and purple, and his veins were bulging with anger.He is the number one scholar, and he should be the most dazzling person in Kyoto today.But now, the limelight has been stolen by that little poetry fairy."Damn, you hidden scum, who do you think you are? You dare to fight with me?" Tang Hua clenched his fists and said with mad hatred: "No matter who you are, I will trample you under my feet and let you know what it means to be a man of heaven and earth!" Di Cang looked at the expressions of Tang Jing, Liu Wen and others, not to mention the expressions on their faces.Don't tell me, this feeling that only you know when others don't know is quite cool!"Your Majesty, it is my great fortune that the little Poet Fairy has such a talent." Tang Jing was too lazy to guess any more and went straight out to ask Emperor Yanwen: "I don't know who this extraordinary talent is. Please introduce him to me." All the ministers' eyes also fell on Emperor Yanwen.The eyes are extremely complicated.Expectation, heat, anger, hatred... Emperor Yan Wen knew very well that there were many people here who wanted to know Tang Yi's identity, and they simply wanted to get rid of them after confirming his identity.It's just Tang Jing, that's your son!How will you cope if you don’t know the day when the truth is revealed?Emperor Yan Wen glanced at Tang Jing meaningfully, sneered and said, "Don't worry, dear friends, you will be able to see him in a few days." "I also look forward to introducing him to you dear friends." Hum, I really want to know how wonderful your faces will be when you know Tang Yi's identity.I really can’t wait for the Shenyuan Poetry Festival."Let's get down to business. Zhongshu drafted a decree and hurriedly sent it to the Prime Minister after 800 miles, asking him to postpone his return to Beijing and immediately return to the Eastern Territory to assist General Su Ding'an in presiding over the overall situation in the Eastern Territory." "In the Northern Territory, the border army commander Qin Jian will be in charge of the overall situation, and the Metropolitan Procuratorate will select a few more censors.Go north to help, aren't you very good at talking?I want to see if you have the same demeanor as Prince Fu did." "Finally..." Emperor Yan Wen glanced at the audience coldly: "It's time to pay back the money!" Upon hearing this, all the ministers were stunned.Pay back the money?What more money?!Emperor Yanwen snorted coldly and said: "You take...no, the borrowed silver from the treasury, you will return it yourself within ten days." "In ten days, I will send people to personally investigate the case. If you are found out by then, I will definitely kill you!" "You...you forced me to do this!" Emperor Yanwen flicked his sleeves and turned to leave.Speaking of which, if there are still people looking for death, it's no one's fault.After hearing Emperor Yanwen's words, many ministers turned pale and broke out in cold sweat.Most of the money from the treasury was borrowed by them, but from beginning to end, they never thought about paying it back.Now, the emperor asked them to pay back the money!"Little Poet Fairy, Little Poet Fairy again!" Compared with the debt, Tang Jing was more concerned about Little Poet Fairy's identity.He looked at Zhao Ke, the Minister of Justice, beside him, and asked in a deep voice: "Why, you still haven't found out who the little Shixian is?" Zhao Ke looked at Tang Jing and said coldly: "The little Shixian we found is your youngest son, Tang Yi." Tang Yi?Tang Jing and Tang Hua looked at each other and couldn't help but sneered: "It's impossible, it can't be him. He can't even recognize the words, how could he be that kind of poetry fairy?" Zhao Ke's face turned pale and he said, "It's just because it's impossible, so I didn't announce it. He might be someone deliberately diverting attention in order to confuse the public." Is there anyone?Who else but the emperor?Tang Jing pondered for a moment, nodded slightly and said, "Then investigate quickly and find this person first. This person is too much of a threat!" The emperor was easy to deal with in the past, but since he came into contact with that little poetry fairy, he felt out of control!If this continues, who can bear it?After finishing speaking, Tang Jing raised his hands and looked at the audience, smiling and speaking.
title_en: Chapter 45 Tang Jing goes further and further on the road of seeking death
